scope: Indonesia-first with Phase 2 ASEAN job discovery

jobs.title: Admin Marketing
jobs.description:
hartono mobil membuka lowongan pekerjaan untuk posisi admin marketing di area bandar lampung. perusahaan bergerak dalam bidang jual beli mobil bekas berkualitas. pekerjaan mencakup pengelolaan operasional media sosial, pembuatan materi promosi, serta penanganan tugas administrasi pemasaran.

pelamar harus seorang wanita berpenampilan menarik yang mampu mengoperasikan media sosial dan mahir menggunakan aplikasi canva. kandidat yang memiliki domisili dekat dengan lokasi penempatan di korpri jalur 2, bandar lampung lebih diutamakan.

jobs.title: ACCOUNTING & TAX
jobs.description:
deskripsi pekerjaan: 1. menginput dan mengupdate data omset harian cabang (baik non maupun tax) secara akurat dan tepat waktu. 2. mampu mengerjakan pembukuan dan akuntansi dasar. membuat dan menyimpan lembar kerja akuntansi. 3. memeriksa keakuratan laporan, angka dan pencatatan lainnya. 4. mencocokkan dan melaporkan jika terjadi perbedaan pada laporan membuat laporan pajak pph 21, ppn, pph 23, pph 4(2), pib & peb 5. membuat spt tahunan.

persyaratan pekerjaan: 1. lulusan d3/s1 akuntansi atau sejenis 2. menguasai prinsip-prinsip dan prosedur pencatatan akuntansi dari awal hingga akhir sesuai dengan sak yang berlaku. 3. memahami konsep-konsep perpajakan 4. minimal 3 tahun pengalaman di bidang terkait 5. memiliki brevet a & b (nilai plus) jujur, teliti dan disiplin, serta dapat berkomunikasi dengan baik. 6. sanggup bekerja dibawah tekanan dan deadline bersedia travelling

jobs.title: Merchant Succes Executive (Sales)
jobs.description:
kami mencari merchant succes executive (sales) untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. bertanggung jawab untuk meningkatkan penjualan dan mencapai target penjualan. melakukan analisis pasar dan kompetitor, serta membangun hubungan dengan merchant.

laki-laki/wanita usia maks 35 tahun, minimum pendidikan sma sederajat, memiliki pengalaman sebagai sales fmcg, memiliki komunikasi skill yang baik, memiliki kendaraan roda dua, memiliki sim c aktif, pengalaman menjual mesin edc & akuisisi

jobs.title: Marketing Wisata
jobs.description:
water world lampung sedang membuka lowongan untuk posisi marketing wisata yang akan ditempatkan di cabang metro, padel world metro. posisi ini bertanggung jawab untuk melakukan pemasaran terkait layanan wisata. perusahaan menawarkan benefit berupa gaji bulanan, komisi harian, pelatihan gratis, jenjang karier, serta fasilitas mess.

kualifikasi yang dibutuhkan adalah laki-laki atau perempuan dengan usia maksimal 25 tahun. kandidat harus memiliki pendidikan minimal sma/smk dan tidak sedang dalam masa perkuliahan. selain itu, kandidat wajib memiliki kemampuan public speaking yang baik.

jobs.title: Tentor Tetap MIPA & IPS
jobs.description:
seventh education membuka lowongan untuk posisi tentor tetap mipa & ips yang akan ditempatkan di banjarnegara kota. posisi ini bertanggung jawab untuk memberikan pengajaran kepada siswa tingkat smp dan sma untuk mata pelajaran matematika, ipa, ips, kimia, fisika, geografi, ekonomi, serta persiapan snbt-utbk.

pendidikan minimal d3 atau s1 dari semua jurusan. memiliki kemampuan mengajar mata pelajaran matematika, ipa, ips, kimia, fisika, geografi, ekonomi, atau materi snbt-utbk. memiliki pengalaman mengajar sebelumnya dan memiliki perilaku yang baik.

jobs.title: Merchant Succes Executive (Sales)
jobs.description:
bukuwarung sedang mencari merchant succes executive (sales) untuk melakukan akuisisi merchant dan penjualan mesin edc di berbagai wilayah di jawa tengah dan diy. posisi ini bertanggung jawab untuk memperluas jaringan merchant dengan dukungan gaji pokok, tunjangan pulsa dan transportasi, serta jaminan bpjs.

pria atau wanita dengan usia maksimal 35 tahun dan pendidikan minimal sma sederajat. kandidat wajib memiliki pengalaman sebagai sales fmcg, kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, serta memiliki kendaraan roda dua dan sim c aktif. pengalaman dalam menjual mesin edc dan akuisisi sangat diutamakan.

jobs.title: E-Commerce Specialist
jobs.description:
posisi e-commerce specialist di master kuliner indonesia bertanggung jawab untuk mengelola operasional toko online di platform shopee dan tiktok shop. tugas utamanya meliputi pembaruan produk, pengaturan harga, manajemen stok, serta tampilan toko. selain itu, kandidat akan menjalankan strategi penjualan melalui program promo, campaign marketplace, voucher, dan live shopping, serta melakukan analisis data penjualan untuk mengoptimalkan performa toko.

kandidat harus wanita, taat shalat 5 waktu, berhijab, dan tidak merokok dengan usia 18-25 tahun. pendidikan minimal d3/s1 dari jurusan manajemen, pemasaran, bisnis, atau bidang relevan. memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun mengelola marketplace, terutama shopee dan tiktok shop. memahami pengelolaan produk, promo, campaign, dan strategi peningkatan penjualan online. mampu membaca data penjualan dan menyusun laporan menggunakan excel atau google sheets. memiliki sifat teliti, komunikatif, proaktif, mampu bekerja dalam tim, dan terbiasa dengan target.

jobs.title: NIGERIA - FINANCE HEAD OF DEPARTMENT (M/F) - ABUJA
jobs.description:
## About us

**Desired start date: 20/12/2026**
**Duration of the mission: 6 months**
**Location: Abuja**

**SOLIDARITES INTERNATIONAL (SI)** is an international humanitarian aid association which, since more than 40 years, has been providing assistance to populations affected by armed conflicts and natural disasters by meeting their basic needs for food, water and shelter. Particularly committed to the fight against diseases linked to unsafe water, the leading cause of death in the world, SI's interventions provide expertise in the field of access to drinking water, sanitation and hygiene promotion, but also in the essential area of food security and livelihoods. Present in 26 countries, the SI teams – 3200 people in total, made up of expatriates, national staff, permanent staff at HQ, and a few volunteers - intervene with professionalism and commitment while respecting cultural norms.

## About the mission

SI has been present in Nigeria for 10 years - since 2016 in Northeast Nigeria and 2020 in the Northwest.

SI’s coordination office is in Abuja and there are 2 regional base: In Maiduguri for the NE, including 2 sub base in Monguno and Ngala. In Gusau (Zamfara state) for the NW programs inclusing 1 sub offices in Birnin Kebbi (Kebbi State).

In the Northeast, SI operates in 3 LGAs of Borno state (Monguno, Ngala and Konduga). SI has also intervened in other LGAs includingJere, Maiduguri MMC, Dikwa, Gwoza and Bama in the recent past.as well as emergency operation in Adamawa State.

In the Northwest, SI intervenes in 5 LGAs of Zamfara state: Gusau, Anka, Talata Mafara, Zurmi and Kaura Namoda. SI also newly opened a base (2026) in Birnin Kebbi, to operate in 6 LGAs of Kebbi State related to an INTPA project. SI also carry out emergency interventions in Sokoto and Katsina States.

The annual volume of the Nigeria mission is between 6 and 7 million USD.

SI's mission in Nigeria responds to the critical needs of populations affected by conflict, natural disasters and epidemics in the North East and North West of the country, through its traditional sectors of intervention, namely WASH, FSL and Shelter. SI is currently funded by a number of institutional donors, including ECHO, CDCS, INTPA, SIDA RRM and NHF (US funding), with the possibility of further funding depending on the development of the mission's projects.

The mission also relies on a partnership approach, localization and good coordination to strengthen its intervention in the country. It works closely with local partners and participates actively in existing coordination platforms.

Mission staff : 147
The Finance HOD will directly manage the Finance coordination team composed of :
\- A Deputy Head of Finance Department
\- A Senior Accountant
She/he will closely work with all Departmental Heads, Field Coordinators and Project Managers of the mission.
The Finance HOD will report to the Country Director and be in link with Finance department in HQ.

## About the job

**General objective:**

The finance coordinator will direct and coordinate all accounting and financial services associated withthe mission.
As coordinator, he/she is responsible for guaranteeing the financial balance of the mission and for ensuring that all
Solidarités International procedures, donor procedures and all laws of the country in which Solidarités International is
intervening are respected.
He/she is the point of reference for the mission, and the link between headquarters and the mission for all matters
relating to management, accounting and budget monitoring.

**The main challenges:**

Financial Coordination of a mission with several sub-bases including limited access / Financial sustainability of the mission in an ever changing donor dynamic

**Priorities for the 2/3 first months:**

\*Financial reporting of the terminated Grants, proposal development, internal financial analysis, contribution in defining the FSPs for CBI activities
\*Capacity building and strenghtning of the finance team (coordination and bases).

**Security constraints:**

No walking policy everywhere in the country / Security situation calm in Abuja, level 2 (out of 5), Maiduguri, Kebbi and Gusau is level 3 level 4 isub-bases (Borno state and Zamfara state).
Level 3 & 4 are requiring strict appliance of security protocol as well as restricted movement and access based on managerial validation.

## Your profile

**Diploma and experience :**

Diploma : Bachelor or masters in a related field

EXPERIMENT IN THE HUMANITARIAN SECTOR : 5 years and more

EXPERIMENT ON SIMILAR POSITIONS : 3/4 years

**SKILLS**

Technical skills :

1\. Master skills on Excel and accounting software (SAGA preferrable)

2\. Capacity to lead and design budget for new proposal in link with SI Nigeria mission strategy, donor compliance and team work

3\. Strong financial analytical skills required (monthly financial analysis are required)

Transversal skills :

1\. Ability to work under pressure

2\. Patient, self-control and solution oriented

3\. Ability to render financial information accessible towards several audience

4\. Strong interdepartmental & coordination skills

**Languages** :

1\. English (fluent - mandatory)

2\. French (an asset)

## SI will offer you

**A salaried position:**
**According to experience,** starting from EUR 2860 gross per month (2600 base salary + 10% annual leave allowance paid monthly) and a monthly Per Diem of USD 600.

SI also covers accommodation costs and travel expenses between the expatriate's country of origin and the place of assignment.

**Breaks:** During the assignment, a system of alternation between work and time off is implemented at the rate of 7 working days every three months (with a USD 850 break allowance, allocated by Sl). To these breaks periods, SI grants one (1) additional rest day per month worked.

**Insurance package:** Expatriates benefit from an insurance package which refunds all healthcare expenses (including medical and surgical expenses, dental care and ophthalmological expenses, repatriation) and a welfare system including war risks. Essential vaccination and antimalarial treatment costs are refunded.

**LIVING CONDITIONS:**

The Finance HOD will be based in Abuja with frequent field visit expected in the regional offices (Maiduguri. Birnin Kebbi and Gusau).
In Abuja, living condition are good and all commodities and goods (local or imported) can be found (supermarket, restautant, cinema, sport centers ...). Abuja GH is Comfortable with private bedroom and bathroom, 24/7 electricity and internet. GH is located in the same estate as the office, avoiding taking the car every morning but still clearly separated from working area (not the same building). Estate where GH/Office is located is providing Gym room, Swimming pool and squash court.
At base level, (Maiduguri, Birnin Kebbi and Gusau), the bases offers a comfortable environment, in spite of limited movements outside of the compound for security reasons. The Guest House offers good living conditions, with private bedroom and bathroom and shared & comfortable common spaces. Electricity and internet are available at the office and at the GH at all times. Ping pong, pool table and some gym equipment are available in the GH in Maiduguri. All essential good (food, hygiene etc..) can be bought locally in the small shops around the office, or in the pre-validated supermarket. Visits to other NGOs are possible, as well as some pre-validated places (hotel and restaurants).
Occasional field visit in NE sub bases, to ensure a correct financial overview depending on the security context and validation. No Overnight are possible in NE sub bases, only daily round trip with UNHAS are possible.

jobs.title: Gerente de Proyecto - Carabobo
jobs.company: Agency for Technical Cooperation and Development
jobs.description:
Acted es una ONG internacional sin ánimo de lucro con sede en París, Francia con operaciones en más de 40 países a nivel mundial. La misión de Acted es aportar asistencia humanitaria inmediata a aquellos que se encuentren en situación de necesidad al mismo tiempo que genera oportunidades a largo plazo para un crecimiento durable. Acted opera en contextos de catástrofe natural, conflicto armado y crisis socioeconómica.

Actualmente, Acted está buscando un/a gerente de proyecto para integrar nuestro equipo en la misión de Venezuela.

El/la Gerente de Proyecto, se encargará de liderar integralmente el ciclo de vida de las intervenciones en respuesta a la emergencia humanitaria post-terremoto del 24-06-2026, concentrando las acciones en la zona impactada de Morón, Estado Carabobo. Entre sus principales responsabilidades, se encargará de planificar las actividades estratégicas, realizar el seguimiento operativo en terreno para mitigar riesgos y gestionar los recursos humanos, logísticos y financieros (FLATS). Asimismo, asumirá la representación institucional de la organización ante clústeres y autoridades locales, asegurando el estricto cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad y normativas del donante.

**Funciones**

**Gestión y Ciclo de Proyecto**

- Planificar las actividades mediante la elaboración de estrategias de ejecución y planes de trabajo alineados con las normas del donante.
- Realizar el seguimiento diario de las actividades para anticipar riesgos y aplicar medidas correctivas oportunas.
- Asegurar la documentación y conformidad de cada actividad, compilando los registros que prueben su finalización.
- Preparar informes narrativos periódicos y actualizar las herramientas de seguimiento para el departamento de Desarrollo de Proyectos.

**Coordinación y Relacionamiento Externo**

- Organizar y participar en plataformas sectoriales (clústeres) y reuniones bilaterales con socios humanitarios.
- Liderar la comunicación con las autoridades locales y asegurar el compromiso y responsabilidad ante los beneficiarios.
- Apoyar la gestión de la seguridad mediante el análisis del contexto y la negociación del acceso a comunidades.

**Gestión de Recursos (FLATS)**

- **Recursos Humanos:** Estructurar el equipo, asignar responsabilidades, gestionar planes de trabajo y evaluar el desempeño del personal a cargo.
- **Logística:** Coordinar adquisiciones, verificar la calidad de los artículos adquiridos y supervisar el inventario y transporte del proyecto.
- **Finanzas:** Realizar el control de gastos mediante la previsión periódica y apoyar en la preparación de solicitudes de efectivo.

**Calidad y Desarrollo Estratégico**

- Colaborar con el departamento MEAL en el monitoreo de indicadores y alimentar la base de datos de lecciones aprendidas.
- Participar en el diseño de nuevas propuestas, aportando insumos sobre costos, personal y opciones programáticas estratégicas.

**Prevención de la explotación y el abuso sexuales**

- Crear y mantener un entorno que prevenga la explotación y el abuso sexuales y promueva la aplicación de la política de tolerancia cero y el código de conducta de ACTED.

**Perfil deseado**

**Requisitos**

Obligatorios:

- Profesional graduado (a) en: Ingeniería, Sociología, Trabajo Social, Economía, Educación, Ciencias Políticas, Estudios Internacionales, Ciencias de la Salud, Protección humanitaria, o carrera afín.
- Al menos tres (3) años de experiencia como Gerente de proyecto. Preferiblemente de proyectos de emergencia, desarrollo o dentro del sector de Agua, Saneamiento e Higiene (ASH/WASH).
- Experiencia en el trato con socios implementadores y autoridades locales / gubernamentales
- Experiencia en habilidades organizativas comprobadas.
- Experiencia trabajando en entornos de trabajo multicultural.
- Dominio de Paquete Microsoft Office.
- Disponibilidad total para desplazamientos frecuentes a comunidades remotas dentro del estado.
- Habilidades blandas:
- Capacidad probada para dirigir equipos multidisciplinarios y multiculturales en contextos de difícil acceso.
- Habilidades organizativas excepcionales, con capacidad para gestionar cronogramas, presupuestos y reportes técnicos de alta calidad.
- Capacidad para mantener el enfoque en la entrega de impacto humanitario con alta atención al detalle.
- Capacitad para trabajar con transparencia y flexibilidad para ajustar la estrategia ante cambios en el contexto.
- Comunicación asertiva y diplomacia para la representación institucional.

Deseables (no obligatorios):

- Experiencia en formación y capacitación.

**Condiciones**

- Contrato de prestación de servicios bajo la figura de honorarios profesionales durante 3 meses con posibilidad de renovación según disponibilidad presupuestaria y desempeño.
- Lugar de trabajo: Oficina de Acted en Carabobo.
- Honorarios profesionales según la escala de la organización.
- Prestación de Servicios de forma presencia y traslados frecuentes a zonas afectadas por el doblete sísmico.
**Moron - Carabobo**

jobs.description:
## About us

**Desired start date: 01/11/2026**
**Duration of the mission: 2 months**
**Location: N'DJAMENA**

**SOLIDARITES INTERNATIONAL (SI)** is an international humanitarian aid association which, since more than 40 years, has been providing assistance to populations affected by armed conflicts and natural disasters by meeting their basic needs for food, water and shelter. Particularly committed to the fight against diseases linked to unsafe water, the leading cause of death in the world, SI's interventions provide expertise in the field of access to drinking water, sanitation and hygiene promotion, but also in the essential area of food security and livelihoods. Present in 26 countries, the SI teams – 3200 people in total, made up of expatriates, national staff, permanent staff at HQ, and a few volunteers - intervene with professionalism and commitment while respecting cultural norms.

## About the mission

With the outbreak of the conflict in April 2023 and forced evacuation of Khartoum and West Darfur (El Geneina), SI was the first international NGO to re-enter Darfur and resume its emergency response. SI is since working in West Darfur, Central Darfur, North Darfur, Gedaref, Al Jazeera and Khartoum, thanks to the support of SHF, CDCS, ECHO and BHA. In February 2024, SI opened a base in North Darfur to provide emergency assistance to populations, as very few humanitarian organizations were operational in the state. Similarly, SI opened an office in Zalinegei, Central Darfur in November 2024. Today, activities are being implementing in West Darfur, Central Darfur, North Darfur, Gedaref, Al Jazeera and Khartoum States across WASH, Shelter and NFI support, Food Security and Livelihood sectors.

In the East, SI is implementing activities in Gedaref, Al Jazeera and Khartoum states, with the main base currently in Gedaref and sub-bases in Khartoum and Al Jazeera. The international staff cover all three states and SI has national staff covering multiple states. With funding from ECHO, CDCS, SHF and BHA, SI covers basic needs of WASH, Livelihood and Shelter. The interventions mainly target IDPs and returnees in the targeted states.

Coordination in N'Djamena constitutes of 22 expats and 8 national staffs. In the finance department, 1 accountancy manager (french speaking), 2 deputy fin co and 1 fin co.

## About the job

**General objective:**

Provide short-term technical support to the Finance Department of the Sudan Mission, SI’s largest mission in terms of financial volume and number of grants implemented (approximately €27-29 million in 2026). The assignment aims to strengthen financial management, improve the implementation of the shared cost model, enhance team effectiveness, and reinforce financial forecasting and collaboration across departments.

**The main challenges:**

Ensuring effective budget control and forecasting within a large and complex mission.
Addressing delays and operational issues resulting from the rollout of the shared cost model.
Resolving gaps in system implementation that have negatively impacted Boussole management and financial forecasting.
Strengthening understanding and application of shared cost mechanisms across the mission to improve forecasting and coordination.

**Priorities for the 2/3 first months:**

1\. Follow up the implementation of the shared cost model, with a particular focus on:

\- Ensuring proper implementation and application

\- Training the finance team on the use of shared costs

The objective is to smoothen the process of the shared cost model.

2\. Work with the Finance Coordinator to restructure the team and its tasks:

\- Review the set up of the team and the tasks allocated to each person

\- Taking into account that the set up of the finance department in 2027 will look different (Fin Coo and national deputy finance coo in Khartoum, 1 deputy finance coo in Geneina)

\- Improve the effectiveness of the team through restructuring the way of working

\- Support the team to clean up and maintain well documented and forecast financial perspective on grants

3\. Work with other departments and field teams to strengthen processes and collaboration:

\- Roll out trainings / capacity building on the use of / implementation and understanding of shared cost to re-enable forecasting at country and base level.

**Security constraints:**

In Ndjamena, the situation is relatively calm, although caution is required. In Sudan, the situation is extremely volatile, and a strict adherence to security rules is mandatory.

## Your profile

**DIPLOMAS AND EXPERIENCE**

Diploma : BAC +5 In admin/finances

Experience in the humanitarian sector : 3/4 years

Experience on a similar position : 3/4 years

**SKILLS**

TECHNICAL SKILLS

1\. Strong experience in Budget management, and different donor guideline.

2\. Knowledge of SAGA

3\. SI finance experience (shared cost, BOUSSOL, AB, Proposal etc.)

4\. Experience in team management and capacity building of team members

TRANSVERSAL SKILLS

1\. Work under pressure

2\. Adaptability

3\. Strong initiative capacities and solution-finding attitude

**LANGUAGES**

1\. Fluent English

2\. Arabic would be an advantage

3\. French would be an asset

## SI will offer you

**A salaried position:**
**According to experience,** starting from EUR 2860 gross per month (2600 base salary + 10% annual leave allowance paid monthly) and a monthly Per Diem of USD 750.

SI also covers accommodation costs and travel expenses between the expatriate's country of origin and the place of assignment.

**Breaks:** During the assignment, a system of alternation between work and time off is implemented at the rate of 7 working days every three months (with a USD 850 break allowance, allocated by Sl). To these breaks periods, SI grants one (1) additional rest day per month worked.

**Insurance package:** Expatriates benefit from an insurance package which refunds all healthcare expenses (including medical and surgical expenses, dental care and ophthalmological expenses, repatriation) and a welfare system including war risks. Essential vaccination and antimalarial treatment costs are refunded.

**LIVING CONDITIONS:**

The coordination team is based in N'Djamena. The post-holder will be living in a shared appartment, with electricity and internet 24h/7. The city of N'Djamena offers a wide range of leisure facilities (gyms, bars, restaurants, cultural institute, riverside walks, etc.) and a large expatriate community. The Grant Manager may be expected to visit the bases in Darfur. There, the GH are of good standard, with fluctuant internet connexion, solar panels and running water point. Social life is limited to contact with other NGO staff, with a curfew.

jobs.title: RDC - Responsable département finance - Goma
jobs.description:
## Que faisons nous ...

**Date de début souhaitée: 01/01/2027**
**Durée de la mission: 12 mois**
**Localisation**: Goma

**SOLIDARITES INTERNATIONAL** (SI) est une association d’aide humanitaire internationale qui, depuis plus de 40 ans, porte secours aux populations victimes de conflits armés et de catastrophes naturelles en répondant aux besoins vitaux, boire, manger, s’abriter. Particulièrement engagée dans le combat contre les maladies liées à l’eau insalubre, première cause de mortalité au monde, SI met en œuvre par ses interventions une expertise dans le domaine de l’accès à l’eau potable, l’assainissement et la promotion de l’hygiène mais également dans celui, essentiel, de la sécurité alimentaire et moyen d’existence. Présentes dans 26 pays, les équipes de SI - 3 200 personnes au total composées d’expatriés, de salariés nationaux, de permanents au siège, de quelques bénévoles…- interviennent avec professionnalisme et engagement dans le respect des cultures.

## La mission

Solidarités International est présente en République Démocratique du Congo depuis 2001 afin de répondre aux besoins humanitaires des populations affectées par les conflits et les catastrophes naturelles, tout en contribuant à la lutte contre les épidémies. La mission intervient principalement dans les secteurs de la sécurité alimentaire et des moyens d’existence (SAME), de l’eau, hygiène et assainissement (EHA), et de l’assistance en transferts monétaires multisectoriels (cash direct ou via coupons). L’ensemble de nos interventions intègre une dimension de protection, soit de manière transversale, soit à travers des actions spécifiques mises en œuvre avec des partenaires. Nos programmes couvrent à la fois la réponse d’urgence — notamment à travers des mécanismes de réponse rapide (SAFER) et des interventions dites de « seconde ligne » — et des activités de relèvement et de développement dans les zones stabilisées. Cette approche reflète la stratégie de la mission, qui vise à maintenir une forte capacité de réponse aux urgences tout en développant des solutions durables aux problématiques structurelles affectant les populations de l’est du pays. La mission est actuellement composée d’une coordination et de plusieurs bases et sous-bases opérationnelles dans le Nord-Kivu (Goma, Kitchanga, Beni), en Ituri (Bunia, Ndrelé, Drodro, Fataki), et dans le Sud-Kivu (Uvira, Baraka).

Le/la CAF travaillera sur l’ensemble des programmes actuellement en cours d’implémentation ou de négociation avec un portefeuille de bailleurs plutôt varié (DoS, ECHO, FH, DDC, CDCS, AFD, FCDO, entre autres). SI est membre de 2 consortia : le SAFER (Ex RRMP) dont MC est le lead est qui financé par ECHO, DDC et FCDO; et un consortium avec ACF sur un projet financé par DoS via le mécanisme GHSD. SI est également le lead du consortium avec PUI et ACF avec des financements du FH. SI s'appuie sur plusieurs partenaires d'implémentation qui demandent un suivi rapproché. Le volume pour 2026 est de 25,5M € et celui estimé pour 2027 à 26M € avec 18M € déjà acquis. Le poste de CAF est lié à la coordination, fait partie de la SMT et gère directement deux Adjoint CAF et un Chef Comptable.

## Descriptif de l'offre

### **Objectif général**

**Action stratégique 1 : Renforcement des capacités et bonnes pratiques**

- Organiser des webinaires Finance mensuels pour développer les compétences des équipes.
- Poursuivre l’accompagnement sur les Shared Costs et renforcer les capacités des partenaires en gestion financière.
- Sensibiliser les équipes à la gestion des avances via un suivi mensuel.
- Poursuivre la digitalisation des moyens de paiement et finaliser le guide/SOP de gestion financière des partenaires.

**Action stratégique 2 : Contrôle interne et conformité**

- Assurer le suivi des recommandations issues des contrôles.
- Renforcer les contrôles croisés des managers et exiger l’utilisation d’outils financiers actualisés pour toute validation de dépense.
- Soumettre les paiements à un contrôle de conformité préalable.
- Réaliser des spot-checks trimestriels, suspendre les procurations non notariées et cartographier les risques liés à la gestion des taxes.

**Action stratégique 3 : Qualité comptable et pilotage financier**

- Fournir un retour mensuel aux bases sur la qualité comptable via le « Check Compta ».
- Animer les réunions budgétaires et assurer la remontée rapide des alertes financières.
- Garantir le respect du cycle financier et optimiser les ressources à travers des budgets uniques pour les projets de faible envergure.

**Action stratégique 4 : Gouvernance financière et relations bailleurs**

- Maintenir une communication proactive avec les bailleurs sur les évolutions du contexte.
- Améliorer la qualité du reporting financier et la coordination entre les équipes Finance et Programmes.

### **Priorités des 2/3 premiers mois**

- Contribuer aux propositions de projets et au reporting financier.
- S’approprier les outils de suivi financier de la mission, y compris les Shared Costs.
- Renforcer les capacités sur LFU, OFU et autres outils financiers.
- Appuyer le paramétrage des nouveaux projets.
- Poursuivre l’accompagnement du département Finance et des partenaires, notamment sur la gestion des avances opérationnelles.

### **Contraintes et sécurité**

L’Est de la RDC reste classé en niveau de sécurité 4, avec un contexte marqué par :

1. Une forte instabilité liée aux groupes armés.
2. Des contraintes logistiques importantes nécessitant un renforcement des capacités logistiques.
3. Une bonne acceptation communautaire à maintenir par un engagement continu.
4. Une désinformation récurrente nécessitant une diffusion rapide d’informations fiables.

## Votre profil

**FORMATION ET EXPERIENCE:**

Diplôme : Si possible master en trait avec la gestion financière (Comptabilité) et la gestion de projets humanitaires.

Expérience dans le secteur humanitaire : 3/4ans

Expérience sur un poste similaire: 3/4ans

**COMPETENCES:**

Compétences techniques :

-Bonne connaissance des bailleurs et de leur fonctionnement, en particulier ECHO, FH, DoS, DDC, CDCS ;
-Capacités d’anticipation et de prise de décision ;
-Qualités managériales, et en particulier compétences en gestion d’équipes et soutien technique à distance ;
-Goût pour le travail en équipe et attrait pour le renforcement des capacités des personnes ;
-Compétences en matière d’organisation et de priorisation, et capacité à gérer plusieurs choses en même temps ;
-Grosse capacité de travail et résistance au stress ;
-Disponibilité, flexibilité, autonomie ;
-Fortes capacités d’adaptation ;
-Connaissances des thématiques et des outils spécifiques SI fortement appréciées ;
-Habitué(e) à travailler dans un environnement instable sur le plan politique et sécuritaire.

Compétences transversales :

-Au moins une expérience probante en tant que coordinateur financier en ONGI
-Expérience de l’analyse financière et de la gestion budgétaire
-Expérience préalable en management d’équipes
-Expérience préalable en management financier avec des partenaires locaux apprécié
-Au moins une expérience de mission avec contexte sécuritaire difficile

**LANGUES:**

Français

## SI vous offrira les conditions suivantes

**Un poste salarié :** Selon l'expérience, à partir de EUR 2860 bruts par mois (2600 salaire de base + 10% d'indemnité de congé annuel versée mensuellement) et un Per Diem mensuel de USD 800.

SI couvre également les frais de logement et les frais de déplacement entre le pays d'origine de l'expatrié et le lieu d'affectation.

**Breaks :** Pendant la mission, un système d'alternance entre travail et congés est mis en place à raison de 7 jours ouvrables tous les trois mois (avec USD 850 alloués par Solidarités International). A ces périodes de pause, s'ajoute un jour de repos supplémentaire par mois travaillé.

**Couverture sociale et médicale :** Les expatriés bénéficient d'une assurance qui rembourse tous les frais de santé (y compris les frais médicaux et chirurgicaux, les soins dentaires et ophtalmologiques, le rapatriement) et d'un système de prévoyance incluant les risques de guerre. Les frais de vaccination et de traitement antipaludéen indispensables sont remboursés.

**CONDITIONS DE VIE :**

-Logement dans des GH avec chambre et salle de bain privée.
\- Cuisiniers disponibles et accès à une nourriture relativement variée, de qualité et adaptable aux différents régimes.
\- Certaines activités disponibles (restaurants et bars. Possibilité éventuelle de faire du sport).
\- Règles sécuritaires évolutives suivant le contexte avec des couvre-feu qui changent en fonction de la zone.

jobs.title: International Migration Data Governance Specialist
jobs.description:
## **Job Description**

**Introduction**

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

**Project Context and Scope**

The consultancy contributes to the the ‘Awda Amina Phase II: Strengthening Miration Governance in Iraq’ project funded by the European Union and to the ‘Strengthening Data Systems to Improve the Managament of Internally Displaced Persons Referral Systems in Iraq’ project funded by the United Nations Internal Displacement Solutions Fund.
Under the overall guidance of the Head of Sub-Office (Erbil) and the direct supervision of the Programme Officer (DTM and Research), The consultant will provide specialized technical support and policy-development support to IOM staff working on migration and displacement data governance initiatives under the project portfolio. The consultant will draft technical and policy documents under the supervision of the Programme Officer (DTM and Research) and support technical consultations, workshops, framework development, implementation tracking, and reporting activities, identify technical and policy challenges, and provide recommendations for consideration by the Programme Officer (DTM and Research). All managerial, representational, and decision-making functions shall remain the responsibility of IOM staff.

**Organizational Department / Unit to which the Consultant is contributing**

The consultant will work under the direct supervision of the Programme Officer (DTM and Research) and the overall supervision of the Head of Sub-Office (Erbil).

## **Responsibilities**

**Tasks to be performed under this contract**

**Data ownership and access**

i. Support the development a structured framework that outlines roles, responsibilities and processes for managing migration and displacement data across government ministries and agencies, in both Federal Iraq and KRI.
ii. Provide technical support and draft clear guidelines for data ownership, access, sharing and utilisation, complying with national policies and promoting adherence with international best practices in terms of data protection.
iii. Under the supervision of the Programme Officer (DTM and Research) and in consultation with relevant IOM staff, the consultant will provide technical input and draft documentation for consideration by IOM in relation to:
i) Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) between relevant ministries and the Central Statistical Office; and
ii) data-sharing protocols between Federal and KRG authorities aimed at enhancing collaboration and access to migration-related data.
iv. Draft a Data Integration Framework and provide technical recommendations regarding its implementation under the supervision of the Programme Officer (DTM and Research), to establish links with the National Referral Mechanism and enable seamless data flow by connecting the digital infrastructure for migration management.

**Data standards**

v. Draft a national framework for migration and displacement-related statistical definitions and concepts aligned with international/UN recommendations and standards, integrating inputs from consultations led by IOM staff with relevant national and international partners.
vi. Develop technical data guidelines and standardized indicators to ensure consistency and comparability across different governmental agencies in the operationalization of agreed definitions.

**Data analysis and use**

vii. Utilize secondary data analysis to inform and enhance policy development and facilitate Iraq's participation in international migration data forums.
viii. Develop recommendations for improved data analysis and reporting on migration and displacement by relevant Ministries, supporting evidence-based policy formulation.
ix. Prepare briefing materials and provide technical support to IOM staff for intra- and inter-ministerial workshops led by IOM staff.Draft recommendations, publication schedules, and other technical documents to facilitate the publishing of periodic statistics on government-owned websites to ensure public availability of migration data.

**Other**
x. Perform any other duties as may be assigned.

**Performance indicators for the evaluation of results**

• Agreed outputs set out in the ToRs are delivered in a timely manner and to a satisfactory quality standard.
• Technical outputs produced by the consultant result in measurable improvements in data governance practices.

## **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

• Master’s degree in law, economics, political science, public policy, demography/statistics, or a related field with at least five years of relevant professional experience, or Bachelor’s degree with seven years of professional experience.
• Proven experience in migration data governance through previous work with government bodies, international organizations or think tanks.
• Familiarity with international statistical standards such as the International Recommendations on IDP Statistics and the Recommendations on Statistics of International Migration and Temporary.
• Familiarity with IOM’s Data Protection Principles and with othe international data protection frameworks and best practices.
• Familiarity with the Iraqi context and government institutions.
• Strong writing and communication skills; experience in facilitating multi-stakeholder workshops and in drafting policy framework, guidelines and technical standards.
• Fluency in Arabic and English.

**Languages**

For this consultancy, excellent command of English is required.

Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.

**Travel required**

Yes

**Required Competencies**

IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link. Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.

**Values** - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:

- **Inclusion and respect for diversity**: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
- **Integrity and transparency**: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
- **Professionalism**: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
- **Courage**: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
- **Empathy**: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.

**Core Competencies** – behavioural indicators

- **Teamwork**: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
- **Delivering results**: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
- **Managing and sharing knowledge**: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
- **Accountability**: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
- **Communication**: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.

**Notes**

IOM covers Consultants against occupational accidents and illnesses under the Compensation Plan (CP), free of charge, for the duration of the consultancy. IOM does not provide evacuation or medical insurance for reasons related to non-occupational accidents and illnesses. Consultants are responsible for their own medical insurance for non-occupational accident or illness and will be required to provide written proof of such coverage before commencing work.

Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.

IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.

IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.

IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.

No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

jobs.title: Líder de Equipo de Gestión de Casos - Santa Bárbara de Zulia
jobs.description:
El Consejo Dánes para refugiados es una de las ONG humanitarias líderes en el mundo, que trabaja en más de 40 países para brindar asistencia y protección adecuadas a refugiados, solicitantes de asilo, desplazados internos, retornados, personas en movimiento y población local vulnerable/comunidades de acogida. Actualmente, DRC está buscando un **Líder de Equipo de Gestión de Casos** altamente calificado con sede en **Santa Bárbara de Zulia.**

**Acerca del trabajo:**

DRC está administrando sus operaciones en Venezuela, bajo la dirección de la oficina de país en Caracas y tres oficinas de campo ubicadas en los estados de Sucre, Apure y Zulia. DRC Venezuela está implementando actividades como monitoreo de protección, asistencia legal, asistencia de protección individual para PWSN, sesiones informativas para PoC, prevención de trata de personas, rehabilitación de infraestructura de salud y seguridad alimentaria.

**Descripción del propósito / objetivo del cargo:**

El Líder de Equipo de Gestión de Casos tendrá su sede en la oficina de Santa Bárbara de Zulia, y será responsable por el desempeño eficaz y profesional de la gestión del equipo multidisciplinario con funciones de gestión de casos (incluido Legal) en el terreno y para apoyar al Gerente de Protección de DRC Santa Bárbara de Zulia..

La posición incluirá la supervisión de Oficiales, y asistentes de gestión, incluido el desarrollo de sus capacidades en las operaciones de protección de emergencia.

**Responsabilidades:**

- Establecer y coordinar el sistema de articulación de remisión de casos sea interna o externa en coordinación con el Líder de protección de DRC.
- Analizar, evaluar y averiguar los perfiles de protección de los casos remitidos asegurando la participación de los beneficiarios.
- Asegurar que cada beneficiario reciba orientación a servicios básicos, en el marco de la gestión de casos, se establezca con el consentimiento informado del beneficiario la asistencia humanitaria necesaria para abordar las necesidades de protección identificadas y de conformidad con los principios de confidencialidad.
- Coordinar, planificar y monitorear las actividades del equipo de gestión de casos de terreno, entre los cuales el seguimiento de los casos.
- Garantizar que el plan del caso identifica claramente los plazos acordados para las medidas que deben tomarse, y asegurar que los casos sean cerrados en un tiempo adecuado al marco de emergencia en el cual se implementa.
- Mantener una cooperación estrecha con las contrapartes gubernamentales y los actores humanitarios para fortalecer la ruta pública, así como la ruta de la cooperación humanitaria en el marco del mecanismo de remisión establecido.
- Trabajar activamente con el departamento administrativo y logístico de DRC para la provisión de servicios de asistencia humanitaria, entre los cuales servicios médicos, servicios de alojamiento de emergencia, servicios de transporte y entrega en especie de artículos para abordar las necesidades específicas de protección.
- En coordinación con el departamento administrativo y logístico de DRC, asegurar que los procesos de compra sean correctamente implementado y legalizados.
- Apoyar la/el gerente de protección en el desarrollo de una base de datos para la gestión de casos.
- Mantener contacto constante con la línea técnica legal a nivel de base garantizando la participación del personal legal a capacitaciones y reuniones con la línea técnica.
- Supervisar la base de datos y garantizar la actualización de la misma, de manera correcta y organizada.
- Elaborar informes semanales y mensuales de alta calidad de desafíos encontrados y resultados logrados.

**Programación y Operaciones**

- Asegurar la implementación eficiente y efectiva del proyecto de acuerdo con el plan de trabajo y IPT.
- Elaborar informes y participar a la escritura de propuestas y presupuestos mensuales / trimestrales / anuales para donantes.
- Certificar que los casos identificados, sean personas vulnerables según los criterios fijados por DRC y asegurar acciones apropiadas de asistencia humanitaria interna.
- Garantizar que la documentación de los casos proporciona información adecuada para priorizar como de bajo, medio o alto riesgo y que las medidas del plan de casos abordan las necesidades y los riesgos identificados.
- Liderar el equipo de gestión de casos en la evaluación de casos y la provisión de asistencia humanitaria. Garantizar que los servicios directos se prestan de acuerdo con el plan del caso, así como el seguimiento y el cierre.

**Coordinación y representación.**

- Mantenerse en contacto con las autoridades locales, los proveedores de servicios y los actores humanitarios para el fortalecimiento de rutas de atención efectivas.
- Colaborar con expertos técnicos internos y externos en temas relevantes del sector.
- Representar a DRC en reuniones internas y externas, de coordinación técnica relevantes, etc.
- Asegurar la integración con otros sectores de DRC, incluido MEAL.

**Desarrollo del proyecto**

- Preparar planes de trabajo y cronogramas por el equipo de gestión de casos.
- Apoyar al Gerente de Protección en la preparación y desarrollo de planes de trabajo a largo plazo.
- Participar en el desarrollo de herramientas de proyectos.
- Asegurar la actualización de las bases de datos de gestión de casos.
- Reportar cualquier problema en la implementación o inconformidad al gerente de protección.
- Asegurar cumplimiento con la política de protección de datos en todas las fases del proyecto.

**Logística / Finanzas**

- Apoyar la supervisión de los compromisos financieros y los gastos y proporcionar información oportuna sobre el seguimiento del presupuesto.
- Planificar y coordinar proactivamente la logística y los movimientos de personal desde y hacia diferentes áreas operativas.
- Iniciar adquisiciones y garantizar su ejecución.
- Asegurar que los planes de entrega de la asistencia humanitaria estén preparados y compartidos con logística de manera oportuna.

**Responsabilidades de supervisor:**

- Coordinar las actividades diarias del equipo de gestión de casos en terreno.
- Contribuir al reclutamiento y encargarse de la evaluación del desempeño de los miembros del equipo de gestión de caso.
- Implementar las decisiones del Gerente de Protección a través del trabajo del resto del equipo de protección, a menudo jugando un papel en la decisión de cómo hacerlo y cómo lograr el objetivo fijado por el gerente.
- Garantizar el cumplimiento de cada persona del equipo con los estandartes y procedimiento de DRC (incluido CoC y reglamento interno) y reportar faltas de acuerdo con los procedimientos.
- Asesorar al resto del equipo de gestión de casos, sobre rutas de gestión y desarrollo de planes de acción para la atención de los beneficiarios.

**Competencias esenciales:**

- Mínimo 3 años de experiencia relevante en protección humanitaria, relacionado a una ONG, agencia de la ONU u otra organización sin fines de lucro.
- Experiencia de terreno y de trabajo en protección en zonas vulnerables de ciudades. Experiencia en la supervisión de equipo y preparación de planes de trabajo.
- Excelente habilidad y experiencia progresa en el manejo de base de datos y uso de Excel. Experiencia en el análisis de datos cuantitativos y cualitativos.
- Habilidades de escritura por encima del promedio. Excelente habilidad en MS Word
- Experiencia en provisión de servicios de asistencia humanitaria, contando con habilidades organizativas y experiencia en logística/finanza.
- Habilidades y experiencia en capacitación y desarrollo de capacidades de personal inexperto. Experiencia con medidas de responsabilidad y cumplimiento con los requisitos de DRC y sus donantes.

***Deseable:***

- Carácter diplomático.
- Capacidad para gestionar las prioridades en competencia y cumplir con los plazos.
- Capacidad de crear buen ambiente de equipo.
- Dominio de la lengua inglés es una ventaja.

**Educación (Incluir certificados, licencias)**

- Diploma o título profesional pertinente (por ejemplo, trabajo social, psicología)

**Idiomas:**

- Fluidez en inglés ( Deseable )escrito y hablado

**Ofrecemos:**

- La oportunidad de pertenecer a una de las mejores ONGs a nivel mundial.
- Acceso a más de 1,000 capacitaciones y certificados en línea gratuita.
- Duración del contrato: según disponibilidad presupuestal.
- Salario: **Banda G.**
- Seguro HCM cubierto en su totalidad por la organización.

**Competencias Básicas de DRC:**

- **Lograr la excelencia**: centrarse en alcanzar resultados y garantizar procesos eficientes.
- **Colaboración:** involucrar a las partes relevantes y alentar la retroalimentación.
- **Tomar la iniciativa**: tomar posesión e iniciativa mientras se busca la innovación.
- **Comunicar:** escuchar y hablar con eficacia y honestidad.
- **Demostración de integridad**:

**Proceso de solicitud:** Todos los solicitantes deben cargar una carta de presentación (máx. 1 página) y un CV actualizado (**máx. 2 páginas, sin soportes**) en español, en la plataforma de empleo de DRC. Las solicitudes enviadas por correo electrónico no serán consideradas.

**Fecha de cierre de solicitudes**: domingo 15 de Noviembre a las 11:59 pm Hora Local. Tenga en cuenta que las solicitudes se revisarán continuamente y las entrevistas se planificarán tan pronto como se identifique a un candidat@ adecuado. DRC se reserva el derecho a cerrar la vacante antes de la fecha límite una vez se identifique a un candidato idóneo.

**Fecha de inicio aproximada:** Noviembre 2026

jobs.description:
**Candidate Verification Step:** As part of our application process, candidates are asked to complete a brief verification exercise. This will involves In place of a cover letter, please complete a short data task. Download donors.csv and gifts.csv from [https://github.com/neilcuz/recruitment](https://github.com/neilcuz/recruitment) and use any tool you like (SQL, Python, R or similar) to answer the three multiple-choice questions there. It should take less time than writing a traditional cover letter. Upload a Word document (.docx) in the cover letter field containing only your answers, one per line, in this format:

- Q1: A
- Q2: B
- Q3: C

**Why we’re asking:** This step helps us confirm that every applicant is a real person and keeps the selection process fair for all candidates. It is not part of your skills assessment, and it will take only a few minutes.

**BACKGROUND**
Over the past 90 years, the International Rescue Committee (IRC) has developed unparalleled expertise in responding to emergencies and helping uprooted communities to rebuild. Founded in 1933 at the request of Albert Einstein, the IRC offers lifesaving care and life-changing assistance to refugees forced to flee from war or disaster. The IRC is on the ground in more than 40 countries, providing emergency relief, relocating refugees and rebuilding lives in the wake of disaster.

The IRC is committed to a culture of bold leadership, innovation in all aspects of our work, creative partnerships and, most crucially, accountability to those we serve. The IRC is a tireless advocate for the most vulnerable.

**The Purpose of the Role**

The External Relations (ER) department was created in February 2020 and is comprised of 3 main but complementary functional areas: Private fundraising, Communications and Advocacy. The ER department is at the beginning stages of creating a radical and ambitious global strategy that will enhance IRC’s ability to ‘punch above its weight’ in private income, advocacy, and brand awareness. The main objective of the department is to enable this organization of more than 12,000 staff to have the resources needed to continue serving 18 million people worldwide in places affected by war and disaster, shape the humanitarian sector by influencing key policies and reforms, and build and grow IRC’s reputation.

We are looking for an experienced and highly analytical Senior Data Analyst to join our team, with a primary focus on supporting our Philanthropy and High Value fundraising teams. As a Senior Analyst within our Global Analytics team, you will play a pivotal role in supporting and driving data-driven insights for our fundraising efforts across the globe.

You will leverage your expertise in data analysis, statistical modeling, and reporting to guide the strategic decisions of our fundraising initiatives, ensuring that we continue to meet and exceed our goals. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, including fundraising, marketing, and finance, to deliver actionable insights that enhance donor engagement and maximize fundraising outcomes.

**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

- Data Analysis & Reporting:
- Analyze and interpret large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that inform global fundraising strategies.
- Create and maintain dashboards, visualizations, and reports to track fundraising performance and donor engagement metrics.
- Develop and deliver regular performance reports to key stakeholders, highlighting actionable insights and areas of opportunity for growth.
- Develop comprehensive data models and reports for external benchmarking to assess performance against peers and identify opportunities for new investments.
- Strategic Insights & Recommendations:
- Collaborate with senior leadership to translate analytical findings into strategic recommendations for improving fundraising effectiveness.
- Provide insights that influence global fundraising campaigns, donor retention strategies, and personalized donor experiences.
- Stakeholder Collaboration:
- Act as the main analytics partner to the Philanthropy and High Value teams, building trusted relationships, understanding their priorities and building strong business knowledge of how these teams operate.
- Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., fundraising, marketing, and finance) to ensure data-driven decisions are integrated into the global strategy.
- Present findings to senior management, explaining complex data insights in a clear and actionable manner.
- Process Improvement & Innovation:
- Identify opportunities to enhance the data collection and reporting processes, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and alignment with global goals.
- Keep abreast of industry trends and emerging analytics tools, and bring innovative ideas for improving the team’s capabilities.
- Acting as a technical leader, collaborate with fellow Analytics colleagues to ensure best practices in coding, statistics, and general analysis.
- Work with integrity and accountability to the “IRC Way” – IRC Global Standards for Professional Conduct.

**PERSON SPECIFICATION**

**Demonstrated Skills and Competencies:**

**Experience**

- 3+ years working in the field of data analytics.
- Proven experience with advanced data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI) and data visualization platforms.
- Demonstrable experience planning and executing complex analytics projects across multiple stakeholders.

**Skills & Competencies**

- More than two years of professional experience with SQL and relational databases.
- Knowledge of dimensional modeling and experience with workflow orchestration tools.
- Familiarity with PowerBI, Tableau, Looker, or other business intelligence tools.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.

**Soft Skills**

- Curiosity and willingness to explore complex and ambiguous problems and deliver actionable insights through both quantitative and qualitative data analysis.
- Desire to work in a multi-cultural environment and collaborate with people from different backgrounds and experiences, with a partner-first approach to interacting with stakeholders.
- Strong data visualization and communication skills: ability to “tell a story” with numbers in a variety of formats: PowerPoints, dashboards, memos, and presentations.
- Strong attention to detail & commitment to a high standard of work product.

**Nice-to-Haves / Areas You Will Grow:**

- Knowledge of philanthropy, major gifts, or nonprofit fundraising analytics.
- Experience with Databricks and dbt.
- Experience with web analytics and behavioral data, and relevant tooling like Heap or Amplitude.
- Knowledge of Salesforce or similar CRM technology.

**Working Environment*****:***

- Standard office working environment.
- Some international travel.
- This role may require working remotely full or part time and part time remote employees may be required to share workspace.

***This is a remote position open to internal candidates based in countries where IRC operates who have the right to work in their location. Successful candidates will be hired on a local employment contract and according to local salary scale.***

***This role is open to candidates located and with the right to work in United States of America and United Kingdom.***

**Compensation:** (US Pay Rate: $85,000 - $100,000/yr; UK Pay Rate £65,000/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

**US Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive set of benefits. In the US, these include: 10 sick days, 10 US holidays, 20-25 paid time off days depending on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163 per month, dental starting at $6.50 per month, and vision starting at $5 per month, FSA for healthcare and commuter costs, a 403b retirement savings plans with immediately vested matching, disability & life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program which is available to our staff and their families to support counseling and care in times of crisis and mental health struggles.

**Standard Responsibilities**

Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies

**Standard Job Requirements**

The IRC and IRC workers must adhere to the values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. These are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Beneficiary Protection from Exploitation and Abuse, Child Safeguarding, Anti Workplace Harassment, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti-Retaliation.

**Related standard content:**

IRC strives to build a diverse and inclusive team at all levels who as individuals, and as a group, embody our culture statement creating a working environment characterized by critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity for us to achieve our aspirations as a team and deliver the best possible services to our clients.

**Recruitment Process**

The process for this role will be as follows

- Screening call online
- First round panel interview online – including assessment / test
- Second round panel interview – online – including presentation task
- Final role and expectations alignment call with Senior Director, online
