jobs.title: Monitoring, Evaluation, and Knowledge Management Analyst (MEKM) [Open to Internal and External Applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP is the United Nations’ lead agency on international development, working in 170 countries and territories to help people build better lives while protecting the planet. For 60 years, UNDP has supported countries to make progress on the issues that matter most, with human development at the core of its mandate. Our work is built on trust and long-term partnerships with governments, communities and organizations at every level.

UNDP Indonesia works with Indonesian partners to deliver an ambitious programme, fully aligned to the national priorities of Indonesia. The strategic priorities of UNDP Indonesia through its Country Programme 2026 -2030 are encapsulated under three outcome areas:

(1) Human Development

(2) Nature, Decarbonization and Resilience

(3) Economic and Digital Transformation

Operating in a Middle-Income Country brings its own set of complexities and opportunities. With 70% of the Indonesian economy directly or indirectly reliant on its natural resources, the link between nature, climate, jobs, and economic empowerment become critical. UNDP’s past experiences and support include innovative sustainable financing, digital health, energy transition and climate policies, improved service delivery that leaves no one behind. Enablers and multipliers such as digitalization and Artificial Intelligence are at the core of its efforts. Building on its vast and long experiences, and the knowledge of its entire team of professionals, UNDP Indonesia demonstrate its thought-leadership and translate knowledge into policy advice, investment opportunities and scalable solutions for Indonesia’s critical development priorities

The Food Systems, Land Use and Restoration (FOLUR) Indonesia Project is a Global Environment Facility (GEF)-funded initiative implemented by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), under the leadership of the Coordinating Ministry for Food Affairs. The project promotes sustainable commodity production, responsible land use, landscape restoration and biodiversity conservation through an integrated landscape approach. Focusing on key commodities, including palm oil, cocoa, coffee and rice, the project aims to strengthen sustainable value chains, reduce deforestation, enhance multi-stakeholder collaboration and improve the livelihoods of smallholder farmers and local communities.

The Sustainable Landscape Programme Indonesia (SLPI) Phase II, supported by the Government of Switzerland through the Swiss State Secretariat for Economic Affairs (SECO), is implemented in partnership with the Government of Indonesia and relevant landscape partners, with UNDP providing programme-level coordination and technical support. The programme aims to advance sustainable landscape management, responsible commodity production, forest conservation and inclusive rural development by strengthening landscape governance, promoting sustainable land-use practices and fostering collaboration among government institutions, private sector actors and local communities.

Both FOLUR and SLPI share complementary objectives in promoting sustainable commodity systems, strengthening landscape governance, facilitating multi-stakeholder partnerships and advancing environmentally sustainable and inclusive development. To support effective implementation, results monitoring and evidence-based decision-making across both initiatives, UNDP seeks to recruit a Monitoring, Evaluation and Knowledge Management (MEKM) Analyst (NPSA-8). The Analyst will provide technical support to the development and implementation of project monitoring and evaluation frameworks, results-based reporting, data collection and analysis, knowledge management and learning activities. Working closely with the respective project teams and implementing partners, and relevant teams in the Country Office the Analyst will contribute to consistent monitoring of project performance, documentation and dissemination of results and lessons learned, and adaptive management, while ensuring alignment with each project's results framework, reporting requirements and applicable UNDP standards.

Duties and Responsibilities

The Monitoring, Evaluation and Knowledge Management (MEKM) Analyst will work under the overall day to day supervision of the Project Manager (matrix supervision), and report to the Programme Manager of the relevant NLCD cluster head. S/he will work in close coordination with project teams, implementing partners, government counterparts, and UNDP corporate functions.

The incumbent will serve as the portfolio focal point for monitoring, evaluation, reporting, knowledge management, and learning across the FOLUR and SLPI portfolios, ensuring the quality, consistency, and timely delivery of results-based management processes and products.

The Monitoring, Evaluation, and Knowledge Management Analyst (MEKM) will lead the strategic direction and implementation of the portfolio's M&E, reporting, and learning workflows, focusing on the achievement of the following results:

1. Provision of support to the implementation and refinement of the Knowledge Management (KM) & Learning Strategy, focusing on the achievement of the following results:

- Drive the ongoing implementation and adaptation of the project's KM and Learning Strategy to meet evolving project needs;

- Design and implement a systematic protocol for capturing, documenting, and archiving innovations, field experiences, and lessons learned continuously across the five target landscapes to prevent the loss of institutional knowledge;

- Act as the centralized focal point for all KM functions, establishing efficient data collection and knowledge-sharing workflows that relieve technical and management personnel from KM administrative burdens and allow them to focus on technical oversight;

- Establish, organize, and maintain digital knowledge repositories and databases to ensure all project-related information and knowledge products are systematically archived and readily accessible, in close collaboration with the UNDP Communications Unit, as well as the Management and Performance Oversight Unit;

- Facilitate adaptive management processes by ensuring that lessons learned and evidence from project activities are continuously captured and integrated into project planning and decision-making;

- Act as the coordinator for knowledge flows and information exchange between project partners, government stakeholders, and other relevant UNDP initiatives.

2. Coordinate on the development and dissemination of strategic knowledge products, focusing on the achievement of the following results. All of the expected results require close consultation and guidance from the UNDP Communications Unit:

- Support the development and dissemination of knowledge products, including policy briefs, case studies, lessons learned, best practice publications, articles, and knowledge notes;

- Compile, analyze, and synthesize project data, monitoring information, evaluation findings, and field evidence to identify key trends, lessons learned, and good practices;

- Translate project results, technical information, and field experiences into clear, evidence-based knowledge products and impact stories for internal and external audiences;

- Contribute to the preparation and quality assurance of reports, communication materials, donor updates, and knowledge products, ensuring consistency and accuracy of information;

- Support the development of multimedia and digital content that showcases project achievements, results, and lessons learned;

- Assist in documenting, packaging, and organizing methodologies, tools, manuals, and other knowledge assets to facilitate knowledge sharing, replication, and sustainability;

- Support knowledge-sharing events, learning exchanges, and dissemination activities involving project stakeholders, partners, and beneficiaries;

- Provide analytical and knowledge management inputs to project reporting, donor reporting, communications products, and learning activities.

3. Strengthen learning, capacity development, and knowledge exchange, focusing on the achievement of the following results:

- Design, organize, and facilitate a variety of learning events, including technical workshops, peer-to-peer exchanges, and webinars for project staff and stakeholders;

- Identify opportunities and coordinate knowledge-sharing initiatives to leverage expertise and lessons from other regions and projects;

- Foster and support communities of practice around key thematic areas of the project to encourage continuous learning and collaboration.

4. Avoid any kind of discriminatory behavior including gender discrimination and ensure that:

- Human rights and gender equality are prioritized as an ethical principle within all actions;

- Activities are designed and implemented in accordance with “Social and Environmental Standards of UNDP”;

- Any kind of diversity based on ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, disability, religion, class, gender are respected within all implementations including data production;

- Differentiated needs of women and men are considered;

- Inclusive approach is reflected within all actions and implementations, in that sense an enabling and accessible setup in various senses such as disability gender language barrier is created;

- Necessary arrangements to provide gender parity within all committees, meetings, trainings etc. introduced.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Competencies

Core Competencies

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline.

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements.

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback.

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible.

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident.

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships.

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination.

Cross Functional and Technical Competencies

Business Management

- Results Based Management: Ability to manage the implementation of strategies, programmes, and projects with a focus at improved performance and demonstrable results. Knowledge and understanding of relevant theories, concepts, methodologies, instruments, and tools.

- Monitoring & Evaluation: Ability to systematically monitor results of strategies, programmes, and activities with a view to make sure that they are being implemented effectively; Ability to provide managers and key stakeholders with regular feedback and reporting on the consistency or discrepancy between planned activities and programme management and results. Ability to make independent judgment of the management and results of strategies, programmes and activities based on set criteria and benchmark, keeping in mind the needs and concerns of client, current and upcoming. Knowledge and understanding of monitoring and evaluation frameworks, concepts, methodologies, systems, processes, and tools. Ability to make an independent judgement based on set criteria and benchmarks. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns.

Digital

- Portfolio Design & Manage Ability to identify leverage points in systems and design interventions that address them. The value of the interventions is determined not in isolation, but as part of the overall portfolio and their coherence. Ability to design processes that extract learning on an ongoing basis from existing portfolios, so that learning accrues over time and new options for action are continuously generated. Build a learning ecosystem around a complex development challenge: being able to mobilise a variety of stakeholders and help them learn and work together. Understand key principles of systems and complexity theory.

- Data Storytelling and Communications Skilled in building a narrative around a set of data and its accompanying visualizations to help convey the meaning of that data in a powerful and compelling fashion.

2030 Agenda : Peace

- Gender: Gender and Environment

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Knowledge Management, Communications, Journalism, International Development, Environmental/Social Sciences, Public Policy, or related fields is required, or

- A first-level university degree (bachelor´s degree) in the areas mentioned above in combination with additional 2 years of qualifying experience, will be given due consideration in lieu of master´s degree.

Experience:

- Applicants with a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field of study are not required to have professional work experience.

- Applicants with a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) are required to have a minimum of two (2) years of relevant professional experience at the national or international level in the field of knowledge management, communications, learning and capacity development, or monitoring and reporting, preferably within the sustainable agriculture, environment, natural resource management, or climate change sectors.

Desired Skills:

- Experience working with a multidisciplinary and multicultural team;

- Experience in the use of computers, office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and web-based management systems, and advanced knowledge of spreadsheet and database packages;

- Experience in managing/coordinating development projects or providing technical expertise at UNDP and/or other UN agencies;

- Experience working in sustainable agriculture / natural resource management / climate-related projects;

- Demonstrated experience in designing, implementing, or adapting comprehensive Knowledge Management (KM) strategies e.g. establishing protocols for data capture or managing digital knowledge repositories;

- Proven track record of experience in the end-to-end production (writing, editing, quality assurance) of strategic knowledge products or multimedia content;

- Experience in translating complex field data/ project evidence into targeted policy advocacy products, coupled with experience executing effective dissemination strategies;

- Demonstrated experience in designing, organizing/ facilitating interactive capacity-building activities/ technical workshops, peer-to-peer exchanges/ communities of practice;

- Experience in project evaluations, analysis and preparation of evidence-based narrative impact stories/ donor reports;

- Experience in curating, packaging, or producing scalable knowledge assets designed to support project replication and long-term sustainability;

- Experience record of writing, editing, and producing high-quality analytical reports/ technical case studies/ evidence-based impact stories.

Required Language(s):

- Fluency in English and Indonesian is required.

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

The United Nations Department of Safety and Security (UNDSS) provides leadership, operational support and oversight for the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS). Its mission is to enable United Nations system operations through trusted security leadership and solutions, in pursuit of its vision of “Security for the UN, for a better world.”

The Security Operations Centre (SOC)* is a cost-shared resource that supports the safety and security of personnel, premises, assets and operations of the UNSMS organizations covered in its operational area. The SOC monitors, facilitates and coordinates data and voice communications, serving as a first point of contact for personnel in need of urgent assistance, and maintains the administrative data that underpins security communications, including contact data for UNSMS personnel, offices, vehicles and emergency services.

As UNDSS advances towards data-driven, analysis-led and digitally enabled security management, the SOC is a central node for situational awareness on security for the UN System in the country. It collects, verifies and consolidates information so that relevant stakeholders can take timely, well-informed decisions.

The SOC Assistant works in a fast-paced and at times unpredictable environment and must pass accurate information and instructions calmly and promptly to UNSMS personnel and partners. Under the overall supervision of the UN Security Adviser and UNDSS Representative, and the direct supervision of the Field Security Associate, the SOC Assistant supports the daily operation of the SOC. The role offers unique and valuable experience to work in a multicultural team that contributes directly to the work of the United Nations.

Duties and Responsibilities

Under the supervision described in Section 4, the SOC Assistant will deliver the following:

- Support security communications and situational awareness. Receive, verify, transmit and relay security and safety messages, alerts and instructions, as directed by the Security Adviser or designated security personnel, through all UN channels (radio, satellite, telephone, SMS, e-mail, web-based and mobile applications). Maintain continuous awareness of the operating environment and promptly flag significant or emerging developments to the supervisor.

- Incident notification and response support. On receipt of a security or safety incident report, log it and escalate it through the defined channels for follow-up and support. In line with local SOPs, alert response and support functions, maintain communication links with the personnel involved, give calm and clear guidance and feedback, and notify the security focal points of the affected UNSMS organizations or UN partners. Provide direct support to incident management when specifically directed by the Security Adviser or UNDSS security personnel and record all related information and communications accurately and in sequence.

- Movement monitoring and personnel accounting support Using UN communication platforms and other tools, monitor the movement of personnel and field missions as defined by the Security Risk Management (SRM) process and local SOPs. Conduct headcounts and accounting exercises in accordance with instructions from the Designated Official, the senior security professional or established SOPs, and report results promptly and accurately.

- SCS operation and readiness. Monitor the use of UN communication resources to ensure compliance with established SOPs and guide users on appropriate practices. Verify the operational status of the SOC (including radio checks and test calls) so that personnel can reliably access it, report anomalies to the appropriate authority for action, and support communications drills and exercises.

- Information management and record keeping support Maintain accurate and up-to-date contact details for UNSMS personnel, offices and vehicles, and for the emergency services and support structures of host-government authorities and contracted private security companies, and direct personnel to the nearest of these during incidents. Keep complete logs and records of actions and critical communications and handle all information with discretion and in line with United Nations information-security requirements.

6. Data analysis, reporting and visualization support

- Compile and analyze SOC data (such as incident logs, movement and communications trends) and prepare routine and ad hoc reports, dashboards and visual products that support SRM and UNDSS requirements.

- Use Office software tools and other approved analytical and visualization tools, including approved AI-enabled tools applied responsibly. Present findings clearly in briefings to security colleagues as directed by the UN Security Adviser.

7. Support with UNDSS functions and other duties.

- Facilitate requisite UNDSS functions, coordinate with UNSMS and partner focal points as required, and perform other duties as directed by the UN Security Adviser.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization

Institutional Arrangement

The SOC Assistant works under the overall supervision of the UN Security Adviser but operates under the oversight of the designated Field Security Associate on daily tasks. The SOC Assistant supports the UNSMS in the daily operation of the Security Operations Center and may be required to work shifts and in specific circumstances extended hours including weekends and public holidays, as operational needs require.

Required Skills and Experience

Min. Education requirements

- Secondaryeducation is required. Or

- University degree (bachelor’s degree) in Political Science, Military Studies, Security Management, Management or a relevant field will be given due consideration, but it is not a requirement.

Min. years of relevant work experience

Minimum of 4 years(with Secondary Education) or 1 year(with bachelor’s degree) of relevant work experience in operational communications.

Required skills

- Computer skills and information management/processing experience; good command of computer-based toolssuch as the MS Office Suite and other web and smartphone applications

- Experience and ability to drive four-wheeled vehicles is a requirement.

- Valid driving license is required. (Copy of valid licenserequired to be submitted as part application)

Desired skills in addition to the competencies covered in the Competencies section

- Professional experience in security, military, police, intelligence or national security work.

- Prior working experience within the UN system, an international NGO or another international organization

- Practical experience with visualization tools(such as PowerBI, Tableau, or Excel dashboards).

- Experience in operating telecommunication systems (HF/VHF radio networks, satellite phones, radio, satellite and web-based communication and specialized tracking platforms).

- Experience usingapproved digital tools,including mobile crisis management apps or basic productivity-boosting AI tools.

Required Language(s)

Professional Certificates

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

jobs.title: Analista de Gestão de Projetos e Produtos de Inovação Tecnológica (1 vaga) (Office Based- Fortaleza, Ceará ) - [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are core principles at UNDP: we value diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate, we foster inclusion as a way of ensuring all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, and we ensure equity and fairness in all our actions. Taking a ‘leave no one behind’ approach to our diversity efforts means increasing representation of underserved populations. People who identify as belonging to marginalized or excluded populations are strongly encouraged to apply. Learn more about working at UNDP including our values and inspiring stories.

UNDP does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of harassment, including sexual harassment, and discrimination. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks.

Objetivo do Cargo e Contexto Organizacional

O projeto "BRA/23/009 - Fortalecimento da inovação e efetividade na atuação da JFCE para uma Justiça Centrada nas Pessoas” tem como objetivo desenvolver subsídios (novas metodologias, ações piloto, estudos e ferramentas) para fortalecer ações de inovação e de melhoria da efetividade da atuação da Justiça Federal no Ceará, valorizando uma abordagem da Justiça Centrada nas Pessoas.

Para o alcance desses objetivos, o projeto prevê os seguintes eixos de atuação:

1. Plano de fortalecimento da experiência do usuário e melhoria dos serviços prestados pela JFCE, com foco no efetivo acesso à Justiça, desenvolvido e implantado;

2. Estratégia para fortalecimento da aplicação de mecanismos de inovação e de tecnologias disruptivas na JFCE concebida, implantada e avaliada;

3. Produção e gestão do conhecimento para fortalecimento do acesso à Justiça e da efetividade das soluções propostas pela JFCE;

4. Plano de fortalecimento da gestão de pessoas e valorização dos servidores da JFCE desenvolvido e implantado;

5. Plano de fortalecimento de capacidades institucionais de governança desenvolvido e implantado;

6. Gestão eficiente e gestão de conhecimento do projeto realizadas.

No âmbito da JFCE, as ações previstas nesse projeto estão em consonância com a missão da instituição, bem como com os principais desafios identificados para inovação e modernização da JFCE, conforme expresso no item anterior e segundo a definição expressa no art. 2º, inciso IV, da Lei nº 10.973/2004.

Sobre a adesão do projeto ao plano estratégico do PNUD, reconhece-se que o projeto contribuirá para o alcance dos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável (Agenda 2030 da ONU), mais especificamente do “Objetivo 16 – Promover sociedades pacíficas e inclusivas para o desenvolvimento sustentável, proporcionar o acesso à justiça para todos e construir instituições eficazes, responsáveis e inclusivas em todos os níveis”.

O(a) Analista de Gestão de Projetos e Produtos de Inovação Tecnológica atuará de forma presencial em Fortaleza/CE, em articulação com equipes da JFCE e do PNUD, prestando assessoria técnica especializada ao Projeto BRA/23/009 em temas relacionados à arquitetura de microsserviços, integração entre sistemas e gestão de bancos de dados. Trata-se de uma posição sênior, voltada a profissionais com experiência em cooperação internacional e gestão de projetos de inovação, capazes de liderar equipes e contribuir para a continuidade das ações de gestão dos projetos, especialmente aqueles relacionados à tecnologia da informação.

Os resultados-chave esperados para este posto visam assegurar a qualidade, eficiência e efetividade das soluções de back-end implementadas, em alinhamento com as metas acordadas e com as prioridades da JFCE no âmbito do Eixo 2 do projeto: Estratégia para fortalecimento da aplicação de mecanismos de inovação e de tecnologias disruptivas na JFCE concebida, implantada e avaliada.

O projeto BRA/23/009 tem vigência prevista até 31 de dezembro de 2027, com possibilidade de prorrogação até 2028.

Deveres e responsabilidades

O(A) Analista de Gestão de Projetos e Produtos de Inovação Tecnológica trabalhará junto à coordenação do projeto na JFCE e da Unidade de Gestão de Projetos (UGP) no PNUD liderando iniciativas de transformação digital, de metodologias inovadoras e boas práticas na gestão de projetos relacionados à melhoria da efetividade da atuação da JFCE e do Tribunal Regional Federal da 5ª região.

A pessoa selecionada atuará sob a supervisão da Analista de Projetos – Coordenação Técnica e Inovação Institucional e da Especialista em Projetos de Justiça para o Desenvolvimento, no âmbito do PNUD, e do coordenador do Eixo 2 do Projeto, no âmbito da Justiça Federal do Ceará. Em conjunto, contribuirá para a supervisão do trabalho do time vinculado ao Eixo 2 do projeto e outros profissionais dedicados a temas de inovação e tecnologia da informação. Também será responsável por liderar a equipe na gestão de projetos e produtos com foco em inovação, tecnologia da informação e justiça, atuando de forma articulada com as áreas técnicas e operacionais do PNUD e da JFCE em demandas de natureza técnica e administrativa.

As atividades previstas para este posto incluem:

1. Monitoramento do Projeto

a. Em estreita articulação com a Analista de Projetos – Coordenação Técnica e Inovação Institucional e demais integrantes da equipe de coordenação, liderar iniciativas e projetos relacionados aos temas de tecnologia da informação, inovação e transformação digital, garantindo sua implementação eficaz, em conformidade com os objetivos estabelecidos e as regras de compliance do PNUD;

b. Apoiar o planejamento, acompanhamento e monitoramento do projeto, incluindo cronogramas, entregas, recursos, riscos, dependências e resultados esperados;

c. Gerenciar tarefas, prazos e fluxos de trabalho, identificando antecipadamente problemas, gargalos e riscos e propondo soluções para assegurar a continuidade e a qualidade das iniciativas;

d. Sistematizar e analisar dados e informações do projeto de forma crítica e articulada, produzindo subsídios para tomada de decisão baseada em evidências;

e. Acompanhar a execução do projeto e apoiar a coordenação na identificação de necessidades de ajustes de escopo, cronograma, recursos e prioridades;

f. Assegurar a adequada documentação e rastreabilidade das decisões, entregas e principais marcos do projeto.

2. Gestão e Desenvolvimento de Produtos Digitais

a. Atuar na gestão de produtos digitais desenvolvidos no âmbito do projeto, em articulação com as equipes técnicas, áreas de negócio, usuários e demais partes interessadas;

b. Apoiar a definição e atualização da visão, objetivos, estratégia de evolução e proposta de valor dos produtos, assegurando seu alinhamento aos objetivos institucionais do projeto;

c. Gerenciar e manter o backlog dos produtos, consolidando demandas, necessidades e oportunidades e conduzindo sua análise, organização e priorização de forma contínua;

d. Levantar, estruturar e apoiar a validação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e demais artefatos necessários ao desenvolvimento das soluções;

e. Elaborar, acompanhar e atualizar roadmaps e planos de evolução dos produtos, considerando prioridades estratégicas, necessidades dos usuários, capacidade técnica, recursos disponíveis, dependências e riscos;

f. Atuar como interlocutor(a) entre usuários, áreas de negócio, equipes de desenvolvimento, consultores, empresas contratadas e demais parceiros, promovendo alinhamento quanto às necessidades, prioridades e soluções a serem desenvolvidas;

g. Acompanhar os ciclos de desenvolvimento, testes, validação e implantação das soluções, apoiando a definição de prioridades e a verificação das entregas em relação aos requisitos e critérios de aceite estabelecidos;

h. Conduzir processos de descoberta e validação de soluções junto aos usuários e partes interessadas, utilizando metodologias ágeis e abordagens centradas no usuário;

i. Monitorar o desempenho e a evolução dos produtos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo ajustes de funcionalidades, processos e prioridades;

j. Apoiar a implementação e o aprimoramento de mecanismos de governança dos produtos, incluindo fluxos de decisão, gestão de demandas, priorização e acompanhamento das entregas.

3. Gestão Administrativa e Operacional

a. Acompanhar processos administrativos, como tramitação de documentos, aquisições, controle de agendas e cumprimento de prazos institucionais, assegurando que todas as etapas operacionais estejam dentro dos parâmetros estabelecidos;

b. Conduzir reuniões técnicas e operacionais, elaborando documentos sobre os temas tratados, além de acompanhar os encaminhamentos acordados, garantindo o alinhamento entre todos os envolvidos.

c. Apoiar processos de negociação, alinhamento e tomada de decisão relacionados ao escopo, prioridades, cronogramas e entregas do projeto e dos produtos;

d. Identificar e articular oportunidades de colaboração e integração entre diferentes iniciativas, equipes e parceiros, buscando potencializar os resultados do projeto;

e. Revisar produtos entregues por consultores, empresas contratadas e parceiros, verificando sua aderência aos requisitos, escopo, objetivos e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.

4. Coordenação Técnica, Liderança e Gestão de Equipes

a. Supervisionar e coordenar tecnicamente as atividades de gestão de projetos e produtos de inovação tecnológica e equipes alocadas no eixo 2 do projeto;

b. Liderar a equipe técnica do eixo 2 do projeto, promovendo ambiente colaborativo, desenvolvimento de competências e alinhamento contínuo com os objetivos estratégicos;

c. Identificar e gerenciar riscos técnicos e operacionais, propondo soluções baseadas em evidências e reportando gargalos críticos à Coordenação-Técnica;

d. Orientar membros da equipe do projeto no desenvolvimento de competências técnicas;

e. Liderar os ciclos de avaliações da equipe sob sua supervisão, garantindo que as discussões de feedback ocorram nos prazos institucionais;

f. Construir as metas de trabalho individuais e coletivas, em consonância com documento de projeto e plano de trabalho;

g. Planejar e gerenciar escalas de ausências da equipe do projeto.

5. Inovação, Metodologias e Desenvolvimento de Capacidades

a. Identificar e integrar tecnologias emergentes que possam otimizar os processos, aplicando metodologias ágeis na gestão e implementação de projetos;

b. Participar ativamente de processos de recrutamento, lançamento de editais, integração de equipes, treinamentos e ações de desenvolvimento, em articulação com o PNUD e demais parceiros, visando melhorar a capacitação da equipe e a execução dos projetos;

c. Apoiar a criação de ambientes e processos que favoreçam a experimentação, aprendizagem contínua e melhoria das soluções desenvolvidas no âmbito dos projetos.

6. Gestão do Conhecimento e Produção Técnica

a. Elaborar e revisar relatórios técnicos, notas conceituais e pareceres estratégicos;

b. Sistematizar informações e dados relevantes do projeto, organizando-os de forma acessível para subsidiar a elaboração de publicações e produtos relacionados à temática de inovação, direitos humanos e justiça;

c. Apoiar a organização e estruturação de informações estratégicas do projeto.

O titular desempenha outras funções dentro do seu perfil funcional que considere necessárias ao bom funcionamento do Projeto.

Arranjo Institucional

O(A) Analista de Gestão de Projetos e Produtos de Inovação Tecnológica estará sob supervisão da Analista de Projetos – Coordenação Técnica e Inovação Institucional e da Especialista em Projetos de Justiça para o Desenvolvimento, no âmbito do PNUD, e do coordenador do Eixo 2 do Projeto, no âmbito da Justiça Federal do Ceará. O(A) profissional supervisionará a equipe técnica alocada no Eixo 2 do projeto e manterá interlocução regular com representantes da JFCE, do TRF5 e parceiros institucionais externos.

Competências

- Alcançar Resultados - NÍVEL 2: Amplia soluções e simplifica processos, equilibrando rapidez e precisão na execução do trabalho.

- Pensar de forma Inovadora - NÍVEL 2: Propõe novas ideias e está aberto a abordagens inovadoras, demonstrando pensamento sistêmico e integrado.

- Aprender Continuamente - NÍVEL 2: Sai da zona de conforto, aprende com os outros e apoia o aprendizado deles.

- Adaptar com Agilidade - NÍVEL 2: Adapta processos e abordagens para novas situações, envolvendo outros no processo de mudança.

- Agir com Determinação - NÍVEL 2: Persevera e lida com múltiplas fontes de pressão simultaneamente.

- Engajar e fazer Parcerias - NÍVEL 2: Atua como facilitador e integrador, reunindo pessoas e construindo ou mantendo coalizões e parcerias.

- Promover a Diversidade e Inclusão - NÍVEL 2: Facilita conversas para superar diferenças e leva isso em consideração na tomada de decisões.

Competências multifuncionais e técnicas

Direção e Estratégia de Negócios / Pensamento Estratégico

- Desenvolver estratégias eficazes e planos prioritários alinhados com a missão e os objetivos do PNUD, baseando-se em uma análise sistêmica de desafios, oportunidades e riscos potenciais; conectar a visão geral à realidade no campo para criar soluções tangíveis e direcionadas; aprender a partir de diversas fontes para antecipar e responder de forma eficaz às tendências atuais e futuras; demonstrar capacidade de previsão.

Desenvolvimento de negócios / Design centrado no humano

- Capacidade de desenvolver soluções para problemas envolvendo a perspectiva humana em todas as etapas do processo de resolução Conhecimento e compreensão dos princípios e práticas de design centrado no ser humano.

Gestão de negócios / Gestão de projetos

- Capacidade de planejar, organizar, priorizar e controlar recursos, procedimentos e protocolos para atingir objetivos específicos.

Gestão de negócios/ Trabalhar com Evidências e dados

- Capacidade de inspecionar, limpar, transformar e modelar dados com o objetivo de descobrir informações úteis, informando conclusões e apoiando a tomada de decisão.

Dados/ Análise de Dados

- Capacidade de extrair, analisar e visualizar dados para gerar insights significativos e apoiar a tomada de decisões empresariais eficazes.

Digital / Analise de Negócios Digitais

- Capacidade de apoiar processos de negócios digitais em uma variedade de projetos, programas e atividades digitais.

Agenda 2030: Paz / Estado de Direito, Segurança e Direitos Humanos

- Acesso à Justiça

Habilidades e experiência necessárias

Requisitos mínimos de educação:

- Diploma universitário avançado (Mestrado ou equivalente) nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins é necessário, ou

- Diploma de Ensino Superior (Bacharelado) nas áreas mencionadas acima, combinado com 2 (dois) anos adicionais de experiência qualificada, será devidamente considerado em substituição ao Diploma Universitário avançado.

Anos mínimos de experiência profissional relevante:

- Candidatos com Diploma Universitário avançado (Mestrado ou equivalente) em área relevante não precisam de experiência profissional. Candidatos com Diploma de Ensino Superior (Bacharelado) devem possuir, no mínimo, 2 (dois) anos de experiência profissional em gestão e/ou acompanhamento de projetos de desenvolvimento, implantação ou evolução de sistemas e soluções digitais, incluindo atividades de planejamento e monitoramento de entregas, gestão de demandas ou levantamento e acompanhamento de requisitos de sistemas.

Habilidades desejadas, além das competências abordadas na seção Competências:

- Experiência no desenvolvimento e implantação de soluções tecnológicas no setor público, organismos internacionais ou em organizações de impacto social;

- Experiência anterior no desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas para o Poder Judiciário será considerada um diferencial;

- Experiência em metodologias ágeis, em especial Scrum, e suas técnicas, artefatos, ferramentas e cerimônias (Kanban, Lean, user stories, brainstorming, Jira, entre outras);

- Experiência em liderança e supervisão de equipes, com ênfase em gestão de projetos, gestão por resultados e acompanhamento de entregas.

Idiomas exigidos:

- Fluência em português é requerido.

- Nível básico de inglês é desejável.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. jobs.title: Driver/Admin clerk-[Open to all applicants]
jobs.description:
BACKGROUND

UN City Copenhagen hosts 10 United Nations organizations that support development and humanitarian operations worldwide. From Copenhagen, resident agencies provide operational support to global programmes through procurement, supply chain management, partnerships, technical expertise, and programme support functions.

The work carried out from UN City Copenhagen contributes to the implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Key Duties and Responsibilities

The Driver/Admin Clerk is expected to demonstrate professionalism, discretion, flexibility, and a strong client-service orientation when interacting with staff, partners, and visitors.

1. Provide driving services to the UN City agencies :

- Ensure provision of reliable and secure driving services following the agreed scope of the UN City Driving services

- Ensure proper use of the vehicle through accurate maintenance of daily vehicle logs,

- Support preparation of the vehicle maintenance plans and reports.

- Ensure availability of proper documentation related to operation and maintenance.

- Ensure traffic rules and regulations are well understood and followed. Avoid unnecessary risks while driving.

- Ensure all safety and security instructions applicable as per UN Standard are understood and followed.

- Report any incident pertaining to safety and operational standards of the assigned vehicle to the supervisor at the earliest.

2. Provide efficient messenger services focusing on achievement of the following results:

- Collection and delivery of mail and other materials as required from and to, government agencies and other institutions.

- Sorting, delivery, and pickup of mail from various offices; maintenance of records.

- Use an office bicycle, where appropriate and as required, for local delivery and collection of documents, mail, and small items, in accordance with applicable safety and security requirements.

3. Ensure Proper use of vehicle:

- Ensure availability of documents and necessary parts in the vehicle.

- Ensure daily, weekly, periodic, and other checks and carry out minor repairs, arrangements for major repairs, timely changes of oil, check of tires, brakes, car washing, etc.

- Keep vehicle servicing record/registration/fitness and other relevant documents for the assigned vehicle up-to-date and maintain the vehicle history book for the assigned vehicle containing all important data on servicing, repair, changes, modifications, etc.

- Ensure spare tools, First Aid Box, Fire Extinguisher, Safety & Security items as required in the vehicle are available and in functional condition.

4. Administrative, Operational Support and Flexibility

- Support vehicle scheduling and coordination

- Support the introduction of a new booking system, particularly for driving services of incoming visitors, VIPs, specific meetings, etc.

- Use basic digital tools, fleet systems or booking system, email, and standard office applications.

- Provide routine administrative and clerical support as requested by the Common Services administration.

The incumbent performs any other duties and responsibilities within their functional profile, as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

Under the overall guidance of the Operations Manager and direct supervision of the Project Associate, the Driver/Admin Clerk provides reliable and efficient transportation and administrative services, ensuring high quality, safety, and accuracy of work.

The role ensures full compliance with UN safety standards, contributes to cost-effective vehicle management, and supports administrative, messenger, and general office functions.

Competencies

Core Competencies

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is a pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open-minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in the face of adversity, confident

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies

- Business Management — Customer Satisfaction/Client Management: Ability to respond timely and appropriately with a sense of urgency, provide consistent solutions, and deliver timely and quality results and/or solutions to fulfil and understand the real customers' needs. Provide input to the development of customer service strategy. Look for ways to add value beyond clients' immediate requests. Ability to anticipate clients' upcoming needs and concerns.

- Administration and Operations — Vehicle management: Knowledge of policy & procedures on fleet management

- Administration and Operations — Security incident management & monitoring: Ability to provide adequate response to security incidents/events.

QUALIFICATIONS

Min. Education requirements:

- Secondary Education (School Certificate (SSC) passed) with a valid driver’s license is required.

Min. years of relevant work experience:

- Minimum of 3 years (with secondary education) of work experience as a driver with a safe driving record is required.

- Proven experience and knowledge of driving rules and regulations of Denmark is required.

Desirable criteria:

- Experience in vehicle management and maintenance, including minor repairs, is an asset.

- Basic elementary knowledge of motor and electric vehicles is an asset.

- Experience in supporting driver scheduling, or coordinating vehicle assignments is an asset

- Previous working experience in the UN, an international organization, or an embassy is desirable.

- Experience in providing routine administrative or clerical support is desirable.

- Proven ability and willingness to use a bicycle safely for local messenger and delivery duties.

- Fluency in English is required.

jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Antecedentes / Unidad / Proyecto

El PNUD es la principal organización de las Naciones Unidas en la lucha para poner fin a la injusticia de la pobreza, la desigualdad y el cambio climático. Trabajando con nuestra amplia red de expertos y socios en 170 países, ayudamos a las naciones a construir soluciones integradas y duraderas para las personas y el planeta.

El PNUD trabaja en más de 170 países y territorios, dando asistencia para desarrollar políticas, habilidades de liderazgo y asociación, capacidades institucionales y construcción de resiliencia, fomentando el desarrollo humano sostenible. En Panamá trabaja a nivel nacional, nivel municipal y comarcal. El PNUD hace parte de las Agencias, Fondos y Programas de las Naciones Unidas en Panamá aportando al logro del Marco de Cooperación de las Naciones Unidas para el Desarrollo Sostenible (UNSDCF en inglés).

Por más de 50 años, el Programa de las Naciones Unidas (PNUD) ha sido un aliado estratégico de Panamá, centrándose en soluciones integradas y alineadas con las prioridades nacionales, apoyando la gestión, implementación y ejecución de programas y proyectos en beneficio de las personas.

El PNUD en Panamá está organizado en tres grupos programáticos que coordinan más de 40 proyectos en todo el territorio nacional:

- Igualdad e inclusión social, económica y ambiental

- Gobernabilidad, paz y derechos humanos

- Cambio climático, gestión integral ambiental y reducción de riesgos y desastres

En el PNUD, la gestión basada en resultados, la igualdad de género, los derechos humanos, el enfoque multidimensional, el desarrollo territorial, la innovación, digitalización y el uso de nuevas tecnologías son transversales en todas nuestras áreas de trabajo y proyectos.

El proyecto busca contribuir al desarrollo inclusivo y sostenible de Panamá al mejorar los niveles de cohesión social mediante la inclusión activa de niños, niñas y adolescentes en procesos colectivos de enseñanza musical. Su objetivo principal es cerrar brechas sociales y promover el sentido de pertenencia, confianza en las instituciones y participación ciudadana, especialmente en territorios marcados por la desigualdad y la exclusión.

Se basa en un modelo innovador de enseñanza colectiva de la música —a través de orquestas y coros infantiles y juveniles— que trasciende lo artístico y se convierte en una política pública transformadora que promueve ciudadanía, sentido de pertenencia, equidad de género y el respeto a la diversidad, al tiempo que ofrece nuevas oportunidades de vida para jóvenes en contextos de alta vulnerabilidad.

Alcance del trabajo

Bajo la supervisión directa del/de la Asociado(a) de Proyecto, el/la Auxiliar de Comunicaciones brindará apoyo operativo y administrativo a la implementación de las actividades de comunicación del proyecto, incluyendo la gestión de redes sociales, la cobertura básica de actividades, el registro fotográfico, la organización de materiales y el seguimiento a requerimientos con la empresa externa de comunicación, desempeñando las siguientes funciones:

Redes sociales y contenidos

- Apoyar la producción y difusión de contenidos sobre el proyecto, sus resultados y actividades.

- Apoyar la gestión de las actividades de comunicación y divulgación del proyecto, en coordinación con el/la Coordinador/a de Proyecto.

- Brindar soporte para la organización y cobertura de eventos internos y externos, incluyendo apoyo logístico, cobertura multimedia, redacción de noticias y mensajes para redes sociales.

- Apoyar la elaboración de materiales gráficos de comunicación, incluyendo videos, infografías y diseños gráficos.

- Apoyar la elaboración e implementación de planes de comunicación en coordinación con aliados, instituciones estatales y medios de comunicación.

- Apoyar la elaboración de materiales de comunicación, tales como notas de prensa, puntos de conversación, discursos y hojas de datos.

Cobertura diaria y documentación

- Cubrir actividades territoriales, talleres, reuniones y eventos del proyecto mediante registro fotográfico y audiovisual básico.

- Organizar y mantener actualizado el banco fotográfico y audiovisual del proyecto.

- Registrar testimonios, momentos clave e insumos para historias de impacto, así como apoyar la actualización de la página web del proyecto.

Coordinación con la agencia externa

- Dar seguimiento y canalizar los requerimientos de diseño, campañas, piezas gráficas y materiales con la empresa externa de comunicación.

- Entregar oportunamente la información, fotografías, videos e insumos necesarios para la producción de materiales.

- Dar seguimiento a los calendarios de contenido, procesos de revisión, aprobaciones y publicaciones.

Apoyar la creación, el intercambio y el fortalecimiento del conocimiento, así como el desarrollo de capacidades relevantes para el proyecto.

- Participar en capacitaciones y organizar sesiones informativas sobre procedimientos internos para el personal del proyecto. Brindar apoyo a otras actividades de fortalecimiento de capacidades, incluyendo el diseño y la entrega de herramientas, materiales para talleres o plataformas que aprovechen la inteligencia colectiva de las comunidades y movilicen la acción.

- Brindar apoyo en la difusión e intercambio de datos relevantes y lecciones aprendidas dentro de la oficina de país y a nivel regional. Mantenerse al tanto de las mejores prácticas emergentes a nivel nacional, regional e internacional relacionadas con el trabajo del proyecto asignado.

- Realizar contribuciones valiosas a redes de conocimiento y comunidades de práctica. Apoyar la recopilación y sistematización del conocimiento, los productos y las herramientas del proyecto, así como su amplia distribución a los socios.

El titular desempeñará otras funciones dentro de su perfil funcional que se consideren necesarias para el funcionamiento eficiente de la Oficina y la Organización.

Competencias Básicas

1. Logro de Resultados

Nivel 1: Planifica y supervisa su propio trabajo, presta atención a los detalles, entrega un trabajo de calidad antes de la fecha límite.

2. Piensa de manera innovadora

Nivel 1: Abierto a ideas creativas/riesgos conocidos, es pragmático solucionador de problemas, hace mejoras.

3. Aprende continuamente

Nivel 1: De mente abierta y curiosa, comparte conocimientos, aprende de los errores, pide retroalimentación

4. Se adapta con agilidad

Nivel 1: Se adapta al cambio, maneja constructivamente la ambiguedad/incertidumbre, es flexible.

5. Actúa con determinación

Nivel 1: Muestra impulso y motivación, capaz de rendir con calma frente a la adversidad confiado.

6. Compromiso y Asociación

Nivel 1: Demuestra compasión, comprensión hacia los demás, establece relaciones positivas.

7. Diversidad e Inclusión

Nivel 1: Aprecia/respeta las diferencias, es consciente de los prejuicios inconscientes, confronta la discriminación

Competencias Transversales

Gestión Institucional

Comunicación

Comunicarse de forma clara, concisa y precisa, tanto de manera escrita como verbal; personalizar los mensajes y seleccionar los métodos de comunicación según la audiencia. Capacidad para gestionar las comunicaciones internas y externas a través de los medios de comunicación, las redes sociales y otros canales apropiados.

Dirección y Estrategia institucional

Perspicacia institucional

Capacidad para comprender y abordar una situación institucional de manera que conduzca a un resultado favorable Capacidad para emitir juicios acertados y tomar decisiones rápidas dentro de dichos marcos Conocimiento y comprensión de los marcos operativos de la organización.

Desarrollo Institucional

Generación de Conocimientos

Capacidad para buscar información y convertirla en conocimiento útil, pertinente para el contexto o que responda a una necesidad planteada. Capacidad para aplicar los conceptos existentes a nuevas situaciones y desarrollar nuevos conceptos para generar soluciones viables y nuevos enfoques. Conocimiento de conceptos, modelos conceptuales y teorías relevantes que puedan resultar útiles para abordar situaciones nuevas.

Desarrollo Institucional

Integración dentro de las Naciones Unidas

Capacidad de identificar e integrar la capacidad y los activos del sistema de las Naciones Unidas, y de participar en las labores conjuntas.

Conocimiento del sistema de las Naciones Unidas y capacidad para aplicar dicho conocimiento a situaciones estratégicas o prácticas.

Gestión Institucional

Gestión basada en los resultados

Capacidad para gestionar la puesta en marcha de estrategias, programas y proyectos que se centren en la mejora del rendimiento y los resultados demostrables. Conocimiento y comprensión de las teorías, los conceptos, las metodologías, los instrumentos y las herramientas relevantes.

Competencias Técnicas

Ámbito Digital y de Innovación

Narración de datos y Comunicaciones

Habilidad para crear una narración con un grupo de datos y su visualización para ayudar a transmitir el significado de aquellos datos en una forma poderosa y convincente.

Ámbito Digital y de Innovación

Redes Sociales

Conocimiento de las redes sociales y capacidad de asesorar acerca del uso de las redes sociales para lograr objetivos de desarrollo.

Requisitos mínimos de educación

- Educación secundaria (Completa) es requisito.

- Estudios universitarios (a nivel de licenciatura completa) en Comunicación Social, Mercadeo, Diseño, Producción Audiovisual, Publicidad, y carreras afines, será dada debida consideración, pero no es un requisito.

Años de experiencia mínima relevante

- Mínimo cuatro (4) años (con educación secundaria completa) o un (1) año (con licenciatura completa) de experiencia comprobada en comunicación, redes sociales, apoyo audiovisual, contenido digital o cobertura de actividades.

Habilidades requeridas

- Experiencia en el manejo de programas computacionales de Microsoft Office (Word, Excel y Power Point)

Habilidades deseadas

- Experiencia trabajando en contenidos como historias, comunicados de prensa, noticias y contenidos para entrevistas.

- Experiencia trabajando con contenidos (narrativas) para canales digitales (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Linkedin, Youtube).

- Experiencia en diseño para canales digitales (banners, tarjetas, infografías, videos cortos).

- Experiencia laboral en temas relacionados con derechos humanos y agenda global ODS.

- Experiencia laboral en instituciones públicas y organismos internacionales o afines.

Idioma(s) requerido(s)

- Fluidez en el idioma español es requerido.

Información Adicional

- Esta posición se encuentra abierta para postulantes nacionales o extranjeros/as con residencia permanente y permiso de trabajo vigente por el periodo del contrato.

- Las aplicaciones que se reciban después de la fecha de cierre de publicación no serán consideradas.

- Solamente los/as candidatos/as seleccionados/as para entrevista recibirán confirmación.

- No se prevé desplazamiento a nivel nacional o en el extranjero. No obstante, en caso de ser necesario los gastos que impliquen movilización, hospedaje y alimentación, de acuerdo con las actividades y requerimientos del Proyecto, serán cubiertos por el Programa.

Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.
